question: The equipment used to record the intensity of an earthquake is ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**seismograph**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **seismograph** is an instrument used to detect and record earthquakes.
 
• It measures the **motion of the ground**, including those of seismic waves generated by earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and other seismic sources.
 
• Seismographs are equipped with a **pendulum** or a mass that remains stationary as the ground moves, allowing for the detection of ground motion.
 
• The recorded data from a seismograph is called a **seismogram**.
 
• Seismographs are crucial for **earthquake monitoring** and are used globally in seismological research.
 
• Modern seismographs are highly sensitive and can detect seismic waves from earthquakes that occur thousands of kilometers away.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Barometer**__

 __
 
• A **barometer** is an instrument used to measure **atmospheric pressure**.
 
• It is commonly used in weather forecasting and determining altitude.
 
 
 
• **Pyrometer**__
 __
 
• A **pyrometer** is an instrument used to measure **high temperatures**, often in furnaces and kilns.
 
• It typically measures temperature through the radiation emitted by an object.
 
 
 
• **Calorimeter**__
 
 
• A **calorimeter** is an instrument used to measure the **amount of heat involved in a chemical reaction or other processes**.
 
• It is commonly used in calorimetry to determine the heat of combustion of a substance.
